title: Provider Context Cache Policy
description: Normalized policy model describing a cloud provider's prompt/context caching behavior, Rig Relay's degree of control, privacy and approval requirements, and disclosure obligations. Content-light: never stores raw prompts, secrets, or private code.

policy_id.description: Unique policy identifier for this provider-cache combination.

platform_kind.description: Platform variant when the provider offers multiple surfaces with different caching behavior.

model_capability_class.description: Human-readable model capability class or family names covered by this policy. For per-model granularity, use multiple policy entries.

cache_mode.description: How caching operates for this provider-platform combination.

rig_control_level.description: Rig Relay's maximum level of control over caching for this provider.

stable_prefix_strategy.description: Whether Rig Relay can construct stable cacheable prefixes that survive conversation growth for this provider.

minimum_cacheable_tokens.description: Minimum input token count required for caching to activate for this provider/platform. Null if unknown or not applicable.

cost_multiplier_class.description: Rough cost classification for this TTL class.

ttl_classes.description: Available TTL/shelf-life classes for cached content. Empty array if caching is unsupported or unknown.

retention_or_storage_disclosure.description: Human-readable summary of how the provider retains cached content. Includes storage medium (GPU memory, local disk, etc.), data isolation guarantees, and expiry behavior.

confidential_context_disposition.description: Whether confidential repository context may appear in this provider's cache, and under what conditions.

explicit_user_approval_required.description: True if explicit informed user approval is required before confidential context enters this cache.

usage_fields_available.description: Which cache usage metadata fields the provider exposes in API responses.

cost_semantics_class.description: How the provider models cache cost: discount on hits, surcharge on writes, storage fees, or free.

evidence_requirement.description: What evidence Rig Relay must record for this cache mode. 'record_usage' = capture usage fields only. 'record_and_verify' = capture + compare against policy. 'disclose_observed' = note in audit. 'disclose_uncontrolled' = note provider controls caching without Rig Relay consent.

ui_disclosure_requirement.description: Minimum UI disclosure level before a user submits context to this provider.

is_disableable.description: True if the user (or Rig Relay) can actively disable or avoid caching for this provider.

current_rig_adapter_support.description: Whether Rig Relay's current LLM backend adapter implements cache control or extraction for this provider.

official_documentation_urls.description: Primary official documentation URLs consulted for this policy entry.

content_light.description: Never stores raw prompts, completions, provider payloads, secrets, or API keys.
